name: LA-2A Tube
notes: Probed 2026-11-23. Peak Reduction and Gain are 0-100 knob positions reporting raw numbers, read through a measured table. They're LA-2A-family controls: they carry between the LA-2, LA-2A Gray, LA-2A Silver and LA-2A Tube only, and are kept for later on anything else. Comp/Limit carries within the family and to the LA-3A. No Mix control.
Power stands in for the compressor's in/out.
